questions.stem: An infant presents with vomiting after feeding. A Benedict’s test was performed and returned positive for a non-glucose substance. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

options.label: A
options.text: Galactosemia due to GAL-1-P uridyl transferase enzyme deficiency

options.label: B
options.text: Hereditary fructose intolerance due to aldolase B deficiency

options.label: D
options.text: Galactosemia due to galactokinase enzyme deficiency
